checks: npm run e2e (Playwright, headless system Chrome, stubbed GitHub client, no writes)
npm run e2e:live (Playwright, headless system Chrome, read-only against the real dev app)
delivery: npm/npx launch of a tagged revision, e.g. npx --yes github:normzhou/yolo-blank-canvas#v0.1.1; GET /api/version reports serverBuild/clientBuild
recovery: Proposed: diagnose, retry on new evidence, change approach, replan, wait/defer or propose governing changes; repair the lowest sufficient layer without expanding the grant
limits: L1 checks run by the harness (`npm test`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run build`, `npm run e2e`, `npm run e2e:live`) plus the GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml, which runs `npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` on pull requests and pushes to main. The E2E runs require system Google Chrome (channel 'chrome') and the live run requires an authenticated `gh`; neither is a CI gate

unresolved: Standing retained findings: PR #23 merged on a pending required check, which later completed and passed; the #2 status summary's stale `PR #1` citation was corrected under issue #43; live gaps in docs/verification.md (first-login path, missing-gh path, browser-open behaviour, multi-page pagination, mid-session auth loss, --repo against a second repository).

Checkpoint blocker cleared: the upstream rule that required `status: "compliant"` and blocked this target's published `"resolved"` reports is fixed by release v0.1.0-alpha.16 (publisher PR #59, https://github.com/normzhou/yolo-dev/issues/40). The finding now reads 'Report omits a required semantic rule', which a later review report can satisfy. No checkpoint is advanced by the upgrade itself.

One status summary per outcome is violated on seven closed outcomes (#50, #63, #67, #75, #86, #88, #90): each carries 2-5 `## YOLO status` comments where exactly one is required, and #86 has none. The contract now states the rule explicitly in .yolo/governance/specs/status-presentation.md; choosing between deleting published comments and amending the contract is a maintainer decision, deliberately excluded from the alpha.16 migration. See issue #111.

Release finding is not repairable in this repository: verification.release.effective_commit was published with three different values (6efd602, dbfdacf2, 80bf5f86) and the validator requires the current value to match every published revision of the marker. Restoring the adjudicated 6efd602 boundary and recording the missing v0.3.1 mapping were probed against both the alpha.13 and alpha.16 tools and neither clears it. Proven unfixable locally; upstream report drafted and not sent because feedback.automatic is false. See .yolo/reports/upgrade-alpha16-proposal.json release_applicability.
